curation.notes: Dual-trap homemade laser tweezers used to trap pairs of human red blood cells directly (no beads) and measure RBC aggregation force, disaggregation force and characteristic aggregation time in the presence of nanodiamonds, magnetic nanodiamonds and ZnO nanoparticles; laser aggregometry (RheoScan) used in parallel on whole blood. Cell-level force measurement rather than single-molecule; Raman, XRD and DLS were used only for nanoparticle characterisation.
